title: Why SoundHound AI Stock Surged Today
excerpt: The voice technology specialist is seeing strong demand for its new agentic AI platform.
content_html:
Shares of SoundHound AI (NASDAQ: SOUN) popped on Thursday after the conversational intelligence leader boosted its full-year revenue forecast.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

AI agent-fueled growth

SoundHound's revenue jumped 45% year over year to $62 million in the second quarter.

Chief financial officer James Hom said SoundHound's recently launched agentic AI platform, OASYS, was helping it win more business from large corporate clients. The self-learning system helps companies use conversational AI agents to automate transactions and other tasks for their customers and employees.

"We are excited by the strong interest we are already seeing with OASYS, which is a testament to the category-defining technology we continue to deliver to the market," Hom said.

All told, SoundHound's adjusted net loss narrowed to $9 million from $12 million in the year-ago quarter. Its adjusted loss per share of $0.02 was also better than Wall Street's estimate of $0.05.

"Our exceptional Q2 results demonstrate the momentum SoundHound is building, achieving a strong revenue performance, disciplined cost management, and industry-leading platform validation," CEO Keyvan Mohajer said.

An intriguing merger is advancing

These solid results prompted SoundHound to lift its full-year 2026 revenue target to between $230 million and $260 million.

Management also said it would provide investors with an updated financial forecast after the expected closing of SoundHound's acquisition of fellow conversational AI pioneer LivePerson.

"We recently secured all key regulatory clearances and continue to expect the deal to close before the end of the year," Mohajer said during a conference call with analysts.

SoundHound AI（纳斯达克股票代码：SOUN）的股价周四上涨，此前这家对话智能领域的领导者提高了全年收入预期。

错过了 2009 年的 Nvidia？ 这个罕见的信号再次闪烁。 2009年，一家名不见经传的芯片制造商英伟达发出了“双倍下跌”的信号。 多年来，对于一家规模仅为 Nvidia 1/100 的公司来说，同样的“完全确信”信号闪烁。 继续 ”

人工智能代理推动增长

SoundHound 第二季度的收入同比增长 45% 至 6200 万美元。

首席财务官 James Hom 表示，SoundHound 最近推出的代理人工智能平台 OASYS 正在帮助其从大型企业客户那里赢得更多业务。 自学习系统可帮助公司使用对话式人工智能代理为其客户和员工自动执行交易和其他任务。

Hom 表示：“我们已经看到人们对 OASYS 产生了浓厚的兴趣，这让我们感到非常兴奋，这证明了我们继续向市场提供的类别定义技术。”

总而言之，SoundHound 调整后的净亏损从去年同期的 1200 万美元收窄至 900 万美元。 其调整后每股亏损为 0.02 美元，也好于华尔街预期的 0.05 美元。

首席执行官 Keyvan Mohajer 表示：“我们出色的第二季度业绩证明了 SoundHound 正在形成的势头，实现了强劲的收入表现、严格的成本管理和行业领先的平台验证。”

一场有趣的合并正在推进

这些扎实的业绩促使 SoundHound 将 2026 年全年收入目标提高到 2.3 亿美元至 2.6 亿美元之间。

管理层还表示，在 SoundHound 收购对话式人工智能先驱 LivePerson 预计完成后，将向投资者提供最新的财务预测。

莫哈杰在与分析师的电话会议上表示：“我们最近获得了所有关键监管许可，并继续预计该交易将在年底前完成。”
